result.summary: Found 4 issues including cut-off content, a broken heart icon state, and layout truncation at the screen edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with the name and delivery info truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped/faded at the edge or add a partial-card indicator so users know to scroll for more content.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image is white/outline while the one on the pizza image below is a solid dark circle with white heart, creating inconsistent styling between similar components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style (background color, opacity) across all promotional cards.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to have an additional category cut off at the right edge, suggesting the scrollable row isn't fully indicating more content is available.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient at the edge of scrollable chip lists to visually indicate more options are scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar's middle search icon appears to have an unusual elongated bar/slider shape instead of a standard search icon, which looks visually broken or inconsistent with typical navigation icon design.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a standard, clearly recognizable search icon consistent with other navigation icons (home, bookmark, profile).
